title: RunningTab: Direct Workspace Interaction with Environment-Side Tabs
title_zh: 运行Tab: Direct Workspace Interaction with Environment-Side Tabs

paragraphs.en: Much knowledge work produces new deliverables from files a workspace already holds, and LLM agents are beginning to take such work over. Through direct corpus interaction, an agent can search and read any of those files from a terminal with no indexing, and producing a deliverable from many of them in this way is what we call direct workspace interaction (DWI). Reaching the files, however, is only half the task: nothing keeps track of what the task asks for, what has been read, and what was listed but never opened, all of which slip through the context window without leaving a trace, so an agent may extract a figure and still deliver a report without it. To address this, we present RunningTab, a framework that equips direct workspace interaction with an environment-side tab : a per-task record of what the task still owes, kept by the environment alongside the agent. Specifically, the agent adds its requirements, while the environment records every file read as an excerpt with its provenance and every listed but unopened file as a candidate; the agent can then see each requirement beside its best-matching excerpts and top unopened candidates, resolve it against matching content or set it aside with a reason, and, should it try to finish with requirements still open, receive them in a finish check. We validate RunningTab on three benchmarks with three LLMs, where it consistently outperforms plain DWI and baselines that keep the record in the model, while its tab usually holds the values a deliverable needs once seen.
paragraphs.zh: 许多知识型工作都是基于工作区中已有的文件生成新的成果，而大型语言模型智能体（LLM agents）正开始接管这类工作。 通过直接与语料库交互，智能体可以在终端中搜索并读取这些文件中的任意一个，无需建立索引；以这种方式从多个文件中生成成果，我们称之为直接工作区交互（DWI）。 然而，访问到文件只是任务的一半：没有任何机制能跟踪任务的要求、已阅读的内容以及仅列出但从未打开的文件——这些内容都会毫无痕迹地滑出上下文窗口，因此智能体可能提取了图表，却最终仍未能将其包含在报告中。 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 RunningTab 框架，它通过在工作区交互环境中引入一个“标签页”来增强直接工作区交互：该标签页按任务记录任务尚未完成的部分，并由环境智能体一同维护。 具体而言，智能体负责添加其需求，而环境则记录每份被读取的文件（作为带有来源信息的摘要），以及每份仅列出但未打开的文件（作为候选项）；这样，智能体就能看到每个需求与其最匹配的摘要及未打开的候选文件，从而根据匹配内容完成该需求，或说明原因将其搁置；如果尝试在仍有未满足需求的情况下结束任务，系统会在最终检查时指出这些需求。 我们在三个基准测试中，使用三种大型语言模型验证了 RunningTab 的效果：它始终优于普通的 DWI 方法以及将记录存储于模型内部的基线方法，且其标签页通常能包含成果生成所需的关键信息。

paragraphs.en: Much of the work in an organization consists of producing new deliverables from files it already holds (the reports, spreadsheets, slide decks, and notes accumulated over years in a shared workspace) ( Xu et al., 2025a ; Patwardhan et al., 2025 ; Tang et al., 2026 ) : a hiring summary is compiled from resumes and interview notes; a budget review is built from a year of monthly spreadsheets; a project proposal is drafted from meeting notes and a previous contract. Large Language Model (LLM) agents that operate a computer autonomously ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Schick et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Merrill et al., 2026 ) make it possible to hand such work over end to end, so that the agent itself locates the relevant files, reads them, and writes the deliverable. A workspace task, then, is not a single retrieval but an accumulation over a long horizon: the deliverable brings together content scattered across many files, and the agent must reach each of them before it can write.

paragraphs.en: To reach the existing files, direct corpus interaction ( Li et al., 2026b ) opens the road: instead of a retriever over a prebuilt index ( Karpukhin et al., 2020 ; Lewis et al., 2020 ) , the agent works in a terminal and applies standard command-line utilities (listing a directory, searching for a term across files, opening a document) directly to the raw files, so that any file in the workspace can be reached as it is, with no indexing or preprocessing. Subsequent work scales it to larger corpora ( Lu et al., 2026 ) , synthesizes tasks for it ( Salemi et al., 2026 ) , and studies how agents search under it ( Sen et al., 2026 ; Subramanian et al., 2026 ) . However, when the corpus is such a workspace and the goal is not a short answer to a question but a new deliverable assembled from many of its files, the agent has to work inside the workspace over many steps and hand in the deliverable at the end; we refer to this setting as direct workspace interaction (DWI). Yet reaching the files is only half the task.
paragraphs.zh: 要访问现有文件，直接语料库交互（Li et al., 2026b）开辟了一条道路：智能体无需在预构建索引（Karpukhin et al., 2020；Lewis et al., 2020）上运行检索器，而是直接在终端中操作，并使用标准的命令行工具（如列出目录、跨文件搜索术语、打开文档）直接处理原始文件，这样工作区中的任何文件都可以按原样访问，无需索引或预处理。 后续研究将其扩展到了更大的语料库（Lu et al., 2026），为其合成了任务（Salemi et al., 2026），并研究了智能体在此框架下的搜索方式（Sen et al., 2026；Subramanian et al., 2026）。 然而，当语料库本身就是一个工作区，而目标并非对问题给出简短回答，而是从多个文件中整合出一个新的交付成果时，智能体就需要在工作区内经过多步操作，并最终提交该成果；我们将这种设置称为直接工作区交互（DWI）。 但访问文件仅仅是任务的一半。

paragraphs.en: The agent has full access to the workspace, but nothing keeps track of the task it is carrying out. What the task asks for, which files have been read, and which were listed but never opened pass through the context window and are soon displaced by new observations; nothing records which of them have been used, and nothing connects a requirement of the task to the file that satisfies it. As a consequence, an agent may open the right annual report, extract the figure it needs into its observations, and still deliver a report without that figure; or it may list a folder that contains the relevant file and never open it. What is missing, we argue, is a record of what the task still owes, kept by the environment and available to the agent whenever it needs it.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体可以完全访问工作区，但没有任何机制能够追踪它正在执行的任务。 任务的要求、已读取的文件以及仅被列出却从未打开的文件都会经过上下文窗口，并很快被新的观察信息取代；没有任何记录能说明这些文件中哪些已被使用，也没有任何机制能将任务的需求与满足该需求的文件关联起来。 因此，智能体可能会打开正确的年度报告，将所需的图表提取到其观察信息中，但最终仍可能生成一个缺少该图表的报告；或者它可能会列出包含相关文件的文件夹，却从未真正打开该文件。 我们认为，缺失的关键在于环境需要记录任务尚未完成的部分，并在智能体需要时随时提供这一记录。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we present RunningTab , a framework that equips direct workspace interaction with an environment-side tab : a per-task running record that the environment maintains for the agent ( Figure 1 ). Specifically, the agent adds one requirement per fact, figure, or element the task asks for, while the environment records every file read as an excerpt with its provenance and every file listed but not opened as a candidate , further ranked by its relevance to the task. Because the tab keeps what would otherwise have passed out of view, the agent can consult it freely, returning to a stored excerpt or a listed file whenever it needs them instead of searching the workspace again. Furthermore, before resolving any requirement, the agent lists them and sees each open one beside its best-matching excerpts and its top unopened candidates, and a requirement is resolved only against an excerpt whose content matches it, or with a reason it cannot be met; should the agent attempt to finish with items open, the environment returns them once, in a finish check . The tab thus runs alongside the task, from the first requirement the agent writes to the finish check, holding what the model would otherwise have to retain and pointing back to the files it came from.

paragraphs.en: LLM agents that operate a computer have shown strong performance as software developers and terminal users ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) and are evaluated in terminal and desktop environments ( Merrill et al., 2026 ; Xie et al., 2024 ) . Building on these agents, recent benchmarks bring them to knowledge work: they pose tasks over realistic office and enterprise workspaces and judge the deliverable the agent produces ( Xu et al., 2025a ; Patwardhan et al., 2025 ; Tang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Opsahl-Ong et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . However, these studies find that the deliverables often lack content the workspace holds: Xu et al. (2025a) attribute failures in part to a lack of ability to understand documents, and Tang et al. (2026) name heterogeneous file understanding and lineage tracing as the bottlenecks. These diagnoses concern reaching and reading the files, whereas our own analysis (discussed in Section 3.1 with Figure 2 ) takes a different lens and finds a loss that these diagnoses do not cover: content from files the agent had already opened, which appeared in its observations yet is missing from the deliverable. In this work, we address this part directly, by keeping beside the agent a record of what the task still owes and of what has been read, so that content once reached is not lost before delivery.

paragraphs.en: Retrieval over a prebuilt index has long been the way a model reaches a corpus beyond its context ( Karpukhin et al., 2020 ; Lewis et al., 2020 ) , first as a single retrieval step and then, in agentic search, as repeated queries to the same retriever over many rounds ( Jin et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . Direct corpus interaction departs from this design: rather than a retriever that decides what the agent sees, the agent is given the corpus itself and searches it with terminal tools ( Li et al., 2026b ) . In particular, Dr-DCI ( Lu et al., 2026 ) lets the agent pull retrieved documents into a local workspace (where a workspace denotes the materialized set of pulled documents, whereas here it denotes the files an organization holds), GrepSeek ( Salemi et al., 2026 ) trains compact agents for it, and related work compares terminal or keyword search with vector retrieval ( Sen et al., 2026 ; Subramanian et al., 2026 ) or builds on it ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ) . However, these works typically target a short answer to a question and improve how an agent reaches the corpus; to our knowledge, none of them records which file meets which requirement of the task. RunningTab instead turns to what becomes of the content once it is reached: it changes nothing about how the agent reaches the files and records, beside the agent, what the task asks for and which opened file each item was closed against.
paragraphs.zh: 在预构建索引上进行检索长期以来一直是模型访问超出其上下文语料库的方式（Karpukhin 等，2020；Lewis 等，2020），最初是作为单一检索步骤，随后在智能体搜索中则演变为向同一检索器进行多轮重复查询（Jin 等，2025；Li 等，2025）。 直接语料库交互偏离了这一设计：与其由检索器决定智能体能看到什么，不如将语料库本身提供给智能体，并允许其使用终端工具在语料库中进行搜索（Li 等，2026b）。 具体而言，Dr-DCI（Lu 等，2026）允许智能体将检索到的文档拉取到本地工作区（其中“工作区”指已拉取的文档集合，而在此处则指组织所持有的文件），GrepSeek（Salemi 等，2026）为此训练了轻量级智能体，相关研究则将终端搜索或关键词搜索与向量检索进行了比较（Sen 等，2026；Subramanian 等，2026），或在此基础上进一步拓展（Zhuang 等，2026；Li 等，2026a）。 然而，这些研究通常以问题的简短答案为目标，并改进智能体访问语料库的方式；据我们所知，其中没有任何一项记录了哪个文件满足任务的哪项要求。 相比之下，RunningTab 转而关注内容被访问后的状态：它并未改变智能体访问文件和记录的方式，也未改变任务的要求以及每个项目是在哪个已打开的文件中被关闭的。

paragraphs.en: Memory for LLM agents is typically written by the model itself and kept across sessions or trials ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) : content is moved out of the context window into external storage and brought back when needed ( Packer et al., 2023 ) , or the agent records its experiences and reflections and retrieves them later ( Park et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2025b ) . Beyond memory that outlives a task, the model likewise keeps its own state within a single task: a plan written into its context ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , notes it writes on what it reads ( Lanchantin et al., 2023 ) , a compact internal state it rewrites at each turn ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) , or, in multi-agent systems such as Magentic-One ( Fourney et al., 2024 ) , a plan and a progress record that an orchestrator LLM writes and judges. In recent work, such a record is kept for the agent and updated as the task proceeds, by the model itself or by further models that supervise it ( Ko et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ) . However, wherever these systems keep a record of the task, it is kept by a model, which writes it and marks its items complete. In contrast, in RunningTab, the tab is kept by the environment: the environment writes it from what the agent read and listed (the agent adds only its requirements), its items are marked done only against a captured excerpt or set aside with a reason, and, kept outside the context window, it is not displaced and is returned to the agent once, when it tries to finish.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 智能体的记忆通常由模型本身生成，并在不同会话或试验中保留（Zhang 等，2025）：内容会从上下文窗口移至外部存储，并在需要时重新引入（Packer 等，2023），或者智能体会记录其经验和反思，并在之后调取（Park 等，2023；Shinn 等，2023；Xu 等，2025b）。 除了能够跨越任务持续存在的记忆之外，模型在单个任务内部也会保留自身的状态：例如写入上下文的计划（Wang 等，2023）、对阅读内容的记录（Lanchantin 等，2023）、每次步骤都会重写的紧凑内部状态（Zhou 等，2025），或者在 Magentic-One 这类多智能体系统中（Fourney 等，2024），由协调 LLM 编写和评估的计划与进度记录。 在最近的研究中，这类记录会由模型本身或监督它的其他模型为智能体保留并在任务推进过程中更新（Ko 等，2026；Wu 等，2026；Ma 等，2026）。 然而，无论这些系统如何记录任务信息，该记录始终由模型负责生成，并由模型标记各项内容为完成。 相比之下，在 RunningTab 中，标签页由环境负责维护：环境根据智能体阅读和列出的内容来编写该标签页（智能体仅添加自身需求），其各项内容只有在与捕获的片段对照时或附有理由说明时才会被标记为完成；由于标签页保留在上下文窗口之外，因此不会被覆盖，并在智能体尝试结束时一次性返回给智能体。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we first formalize direct workspace interaction, a setting in which the agent is given access to every file of a workspace but no persistent record of the state of its task, and then present RunningTab, which supplies this record in the form of an environment-side tab kept beside the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们首先对直接工作区交互进行形式化定义：在这种设定下，智能体可以访问工作区中的每一个文件，但无法获得其任务状态的持久性记录。随后，我们将介绍 RunningTab，它通过一个位于环境侧、始终保留在智能体旁边的标签页来提供这种状态记录。

paragraphs.en: Let 𝒲 \mathcal{W} denote a workspace, the collection of files an organization already holds (such as reports, spreadsheets, slide decks, and notes), and let t t denote a task that asks for a new deliverable 𝒟 \mathcal{D} (for instance, a report or a spreadsheet) to be produced from them. What characterizes such a task is that what it asks for rarely sits in one place: t t decomposes into many individual elements (a fact to look up, a figure to extract, a section to write) whose sources are scattered across the files of 𝒲 \mathcal{W} , and the deliverable is complete only when every one of them has been carried into 𝒟 \mathcal{D} . The task is carried out by an agent, an LLM typically equipped with terminal tools (such as read , which opens a file, and bash , which runs a shell command), which works in turns: in each turn, the model issues tool calls and receives their observations, writing 𝒟 \mathcal{D} into an output folder of 𝒲 \mathcal{W} , and it finishes when it responds without a tool call, which we refer to as a stop.
paragraphs.zh: 令 𝒲 \mathcal{W} 表示一个工作区，即组织已拥有的文件集合（例如报告、电子表格、幻灯片和笔记），并令 t t 表示一项需要基于这些文件生成新成果物 𝒟 \mathcal{D}（例如一份报告或电子表格）的任务。 这类任务的特点在于其要求的内容很少集中于单一位置：t t 会分解为许多独立元素（一个需要查询的事实、一个需要提取的图表、一个需要撰写的部分），而这些元素的来源分散在 𝒲 \mathcal{W} 中的各个文件里；只有当所有元素都被整合到 𝒟 \mathcal{D} 中时，成果物才算完整。 该任务由一个智能体执行，通常是一个配备终端工具（例如 read，用于打开文件，以及 bash，用于运行 shell 命令）的大型语言模型（LLM），其工作过程分阶段进行：在每个阶段，模型会发出工具调用并接收观察结果，将 𝒟 \mathcal{D} 写入 𝒲 \mathcal{W} 中的一个输出文件夹；当模型不再发出工具调用时（我们称之为“停止”），任务即告完成。

paragraphs.en: To reach the files, the agent follows direct corpus interaction ( Li et al., 2026b ) : instead of querying a retriever over an index, it applies its terminal tools directly to the raw files, so that any file in 𝒲 \mathcal{W} can be listed, searched, and opened as it is. We define direct workspace interaction (DWI) as the setting in which a workspace task is carried out with this form of access: given 𝒲 \mathcal{W} and t t , the agent interacts directly with the files of 𝒲 \mathcal{W} over many turns and hands in 𝒟 \mathcal{D} when it finishes. DWI thus inherits from direct corpus interaction how files are reached, but differs from it in what is asked of the agent: there, the output is a short answer that a few passages typically suffice to support; here, it is a deliverable that brings together content from many files, so that what the agent finds should remain available until it is written into 𝒟 \mathcal{D} .
paragraphs.zh: 为了访问文件，智能体采用直接语料库交互方式（Li et al., 2026b）：它不是通过索引查询检索器，而是直接将终端工具应用于原始文件，因此 𝒲 \mathcal{W} 中的任何文件都可以按原样列出、搜索和打开。 我们将直接工作区交互（DWI）定义为这样一种情境：工作区任务通过这种访问方式执行；给定 𝒲 \mathcal{W} 和 t t，智能体在多个回合中直接与 𝒲 \mathcal{W} 的文件进行交互，并在任务完成时提交到 𝒟 \mathcal{D}。 因此，DWI 继承了直接语料库交互的文件访问方式，但两者在智能体的任务要求上有所不同：在前者中，输出是一个简短答案，通常只需少数几个段落即可支持；而在后者中，输出则是一个整合了多个文件内容的成果，因此智能体找到的内容必须一直保留可用状态，直到被写入 𝒟 \mathcal{D}。

To measure how often content shown to the agent is missing from the deliverable, we analyze DCI ( Li et al., 2026b ) , the plain form of DWI, with GPT-5.4 nano ( OpenAI, 2026 ) on Workspace-Bench ( Tang et al., 2026 ) , which checks each deliverable against rubrics, over three runs of its 100 tasks. paragraphs.zh: 然而，在其原始形式中，DWI 将这一问题交由上下文窗口处理，其中智能体所发现的内容仅以一段文字的形式存在于不断增长的观察流中。 为了衡量展示给智能体的内容在交付成果中缺失的频率，我们使用 GPT-5.4 nano（OpenAI, 2026）在 Workspace-Bench（Tang et al., 2026）上分析了 DWI 的原始形式 DCI（Li et al., 2026b），该测试通过三次运行其 100 项任务，将每个交付成果与评分标准进行比对。 我们将 DCI 未能满足的每个评分标准，通过 LLM 标注员分配至一个失败类型（与人类标签的一致性达到 Cohen’s kappa 0.83），并检查评分标准所期望的每个数值是否出现在智能体的观察结果及其交付成果中。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 2 (top), extraction, in which the agent opened the right files but the deliverable lacks or distorts their content, accounts for 51.1% of the points that DCI loses and splits into two parts: Shown but Missing (12.3%), where the content is absent from the deliverable although it appears in the output of a file the agent had opened, and Dropped or Distorted (38.9%), where the content is either absent with no such evidence or present but inexact, misplaced, or misread. Discovery, in which the right files are never opened (including files listed but not opened), accounts for another 17.6%. Among the attempts that produced a deliverable, about one in five (19.8%) of the 891 distinctive numeric values that the rubrics expect and that appear in an observation of the agent are absent from the deliverable, and the rubrics that expect them are not satisfied ( Figure 2 , bottom). By contrast, a record of the state of the task, kept outside the context window, offers what the stream cannot: at any point, it shows which elements of t t are still unmet, which observations have been used in 𝒟 \mathcal{D} , and which listed files have yet to be opened.

paragraphs.en: Recall that a deliverable is assembled from content scattered across many files, often long after that content was first encountered ( Section 3.1 ). Consequently, by the time the agent writes, it should rely on the following (remaining accessible): what the task asks for (so that no element is left out), what it has already read (so that content found earlier can be reused without searching for it again), and which files it has seen in a listing but not yet opened (so that it knows where to look for what is still missing). To this end, the tab maintains one kind of entry for each of them. Formally, for a task t t , the tab is defined as 𝒯 t = ( ℛ , ℒ , 𝒞 ) \mathcal{T}_{t}=(\mathcal{R},\mathcal{L},\mathcal{C}) , which consists of requirements ( ℛ \mathcal{R} ), a read log ( ℒ \mathcal{L} ), and candidates ( 𝒞 \mathcal{C} ), described as follows:

paragraphs.en: Requirements ( ℛ \mathcal{R} ). The requirements are the individual items that the task asks for, each being one fact, figure, or element of the deliverable. For instance, for a task that asks for a short report with several figures from an annual report, one requirement would be the number of new invention patents in 2024. At the start of the task, the agent states these items, and the environment records each of them as a requirement r i ∈ ℛ r_{i}\in\mathcal{R} and tracks its status from then on. Specifically, a requirement is open when it is recorded, and the agent could later resolve it in one of two ways: as done , when its content has been found in a file, in which case the agent cites the entry of the read log that contains it; or as unavailable , when no file supplies it (for instance, because it is to be computed or written by the agent), in which case the agent states the reason.
paragraphs.zh: 需求（ℛ \mathcal{R}）。 需求是任务所要求的各个具体项目，每个项目都是一个事实、数据或交付成果中的某个要素。 例如，对于一个要求提供一份简短报告并附上年度报告中若干图表的任务而言，其中一项需求可能是 2024 年新发明专利的数量。 在任务开始时，智能体会列出这些项目，环境会将每个项目记录为需求 r_i ∈ ℛ r_{i}\in\mathcal{R}，并从那时起跟踪其状态。 具体而言，当需求被记录时，它处于“开放”状态；之后智能体可以通过两种方式解决该需求：一是标记为“已完成”，即其内容已在某个文件中找到，此时智能体会引用读取日志中包含该内容的条目；二是标记为“不可用”，即没有文件提供该信息（例如，因为该信息需要由智能体自行计算或编写），此时智能体会说明原因。

sents.en: In the example above, extracting the text of the annual report yields an entry whose excerpt contains the line with the patent count, so it can be found again without reopening the report.

paragraphs.en: Note that it is the environment, rather than the model itself, that keeps every entry of the tab: it stores the requirements as the agent states them, and it captures the read log and the candidates on its own, since it observes every read and every listing, whereas a record that the model keeps for itself may miss some of them. Specifically, two of them update the requirements: add states one or more requirements, and resolve resolves a requirement as done or unavailable . paragraphs.en: We now describe how the tab is kept while the agent works. Since the tab is useful at a given turn only if it already holds what the agent needs then, each kind of entry is recorded as it arises, by the party in a position to record it: the agent states the requirements at the start, while the environment captures reads and listings from the observations and reports the state of the tab alongside them.

paragraphs.en: Of the three kinds of entries, the requirements are the one the environment cannot capture on its own, since what the task asks for appears only in the task, and dividing it into items takes an understanding of the task that the model supplies. RunningTab therefore adds a short block to the system prompt, which asks the agent to begin by stating the requirements with add and then to work as usual.
paragraphs.zh: 在这三种条目中，需求是环境自身无法捕捉的那一种，因为任务所要求的内容仅出现在任务本身之中，而将其分解为各项则需要模型所提供的对任务的理解。 因此，RunningTab 在系统提示中添加了一个简短的段落，要求智能体首先用“add”陈述需求，然后按常规继续执行。

paragraphs.en: In contrast, the read log and the candidates need no action from the agent: the environment sees every observation, so it records both on its own. For each observation it decides which files the agent has read and which it has only seen listed. However, the terminal itself draws no such line: many commands read a file, and a single command can show the content of one file with the names of many others. RunningTab therefore draws this line from the command and its observation: a file counts as read when its content appears, and as listed when only its path does. An entry of the read log stores the observation as it is, neither parsed nor summarized, so that capturing depends on no file format and the entry holds what the agent saw. Since one listing can name hundreds of files while a candidate carries only its path, the candidates are ranked by the lexical relevance of their paths to the task with BM25 ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 相比之下，读取日志和候选项无需智能体采取任何行动：环境会看到每一次观察，因此会自动记录两者。 对于每次观察，环境都会判断智能体读取了哪些文件，以及仅看到哪些文件的列表。 然而，终端本身并不会绘制这样的线：许多命令会读取一个文件，而单个命令可能显示一个文件的内容，同时列出多个其他文件的名称。 因此，RunningTab 会根据命令及其观察结果绘制这条线：当某个文件的内容出现时，它被视为已读取；当仅其路径出现时，则被视为被列出。 读取日志中的条目会原样存储观察结果，既不过度解析也不进行总结，因此记录过程不依赖任何文件格式，且条目保留了智能体所看到的内容。 由于一个文件列表可能包含数百个文件名，而候选项仅携带其路径，因此候选项会根据其路径与任务之间的词汇相关性，使用 BM25（Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009）进行排序。

paragraphs.en: We now describe how the tab is settled before delivery. A requirement stays open until the agent resolves it, so a tab is settled once all its requirements are resolved. RunningTab works toward that state with three mechanisms: a review that shows what may supply each open requirement; a resolution that names where the content of a requirement was found, or why no file supplies it; and a finish check sent at the stop.
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在来描述在交付前如何结算该标签。 一项需求在智能体解决之前会保持开放状态，因此当所有需求都被解决后，该标签即被视为已结算。 RunningTab 通过三种机制来实现这一状态：一种审查机制，用于显示哪些内容可能满足每个开放的需求；一种解决机制，用于说明某个需求的内容是在何处找到的，或为何没有文件能满足该需求；以及一个在停止时发送的完成检查。

paragraphs.en: Connecting a requirement to the file that supplies it is a link the context window leaves implicit, whereas the tab holds both ends of it: the requirements on one side, the read log and the candidates on the other. RunningTab therefore offers a review that joins them: when the agent lists its requirements with list , the tab returns each open requirement beside the read-log entries that best match it and the unopened files still to try, both ranked by BM25 against the requirement. The prompt asks the agent to do so after exploring and before resolving any requirement, so that it can still act on what the review shows.

paragraphs.en: To resolve a requirement as done , the agent cites the read-log entry its content came from, and the tab checks the citation so that a done rests on what the agent read: resolve refuses a citation whose path and excerpt share no term with the requirement, while unavailable requires a reason.

paragraphs.en: In this section, we describe the benchmarks, the baselines, and the implementation details.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们将介绍基准测试、基线模型以及实现细节。

paragraphs.en: Direct workspace interaction targets tasks whose deliverable draws on many files of a workspace. We therefore use two benchmarks that pose such tasks and check the deliverable element by element (by rubrics or by checkpoints), and one benchmark of QA over enterprise documents:
paragraphs.zh: 直接工作区交互针对的是那些成果需要整合工作区内多个文件的任务。 因此，我们使用了两个提出此类任务的基准测试，并对成果逐项检查（通过评分标准或检查点），以及一个针对企业文档的问答基准测试：

sents.en: Direct workspace interaction targets tasks whose deliverable draws on many files of a workspace.
sents.zh: 直接工作区交互针对的是那些成果需要整合工作区内多个文件的任务。

sents.en: We therefore use two benchmarks that pose such tasks and check the deliverable element by element (by rubrics or by checkpoints), and one benchmark of QA over enterprise documents:
sents.zh: 因此，我们使用了两个提出此类任务的基准测试，并对成果逐项检查（通过评分标准或检查点），以及一个针对企业文档的问答基准测试：

paragraphs.en: Workspace-Bench ( Tang et al., 2026 ) simulates the workspaces of five professional roles (such as an operations manager and a researcher), each holding thousands of heterogeneous files, and asks for deliverables that draw on files scattered across a workspace; it has 100 tasks and 1,850 evaluation instances (one per rubric), on which we report the Rubric Pass Rate (the share of satisfied rubrics) and the Task Completion Rate (TCR@70, the share of tasks with at least 70% of their rubrics satisfied), following its protocol.
paragraphs.zh: Workspace-Bench（Tang 等人，2026）模拟了五个专业角色（例如运营经理和研究人员）的工作空间，每个角色都拥有数千个异构文件，并要求生成需要调用工作空间中分散文件的成果；该基准包含100项任务和1,850个评估实例（每个评分标准对应一个），我们遵循其协议，报告了评分标准通过率（满足评分标准的比例）和任务完成率（TCR@70，即至少70%的评分标准得到满足的任务比例）。

paragraphs.en: TheAgentCompany ( Xu et al., 2025a ) simulates a software company whose tasks are checked by programmatic evaluators at checkpoints; we use a subset of its tasks that need no service other than the file server of the company (such as other websites or external models), with 88 evaluation instances (one per checkpoint), and report Success (the share of tasks whose checkpoints all pass) and Score (which gives each task half credit for the fraction of checkpoint points it earns and half for its success), as proposed by its authors.
paragraphs.zh: TheAgentCompany（Xu 等人，2025a）模拟了一家软件公司，其任务会在检查点由程序化评估器进行核查；我们使用了该公司部分无需除文件服务器外其他服务的任务（例如其他网站或外部模型），共包含 88 个评估实例（每个检查点一个），并报告了“成功”（所有检查点均通过的任务比例）和“得分”（每个任务的得分由其在各检查点获得的分数比例占一半，以及其成功与否占另一半组成），具体方法如其作者所提出。

paragraphs.en: OfficeQA Pro ( Opsahl-Ong et al., 2026 ) lets us check whether RunningTab also helps in the conventional setting of question answering, where the deliverable is a single answer: its workspace holds 697 files (U.S. Treasury Bulletins spanning nearly a century, about 89,000 pages), and the answer to each question is found, and often computed, from these files. We use a subset of its questions that need no external data source (such as exchange rates or price indices), with 104 evaluation instances (one per question), and report the accuracy at an allowable absolute relative error of 0% and 1% (Acc@0% and Acc@1%), as in its protocol.
paragraphs.zh: OfficeQA Pro（Opsahl-Ong 等，2026）使我们能够检验 RunningTab 是否也能在传统的问答场景下提供帮助，即最终输出为一个单一答案：其工作区包含 697 个文件（涵盖近一个世纪的美国财政部公报，约 89,000 页），每个问题的答案都从这些文件中查找，并且通常还需要进行计算。我们使用了其中一组无需外部数据源（如汇率或价格指数）的问题，共包含 104 个评估实例（每个问题一个），并按照其协议报告在允许 0% 和 1% 的绝对相对误差下的准确率（Acc@0% 和 Acc@1%）。

paragraphs.en: We compare RunningTab against DCI and against three baselines in which the model, rather than an environment-side tab, keeps track of what the task asks for:
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 RunningTab 与 DCI 以及三种基线方法进行了比较，在这些基线方法中，模型（而非环境侧的表格）负责跟踪任务的具体要求：

paragraphs.en: DCI ( Li et al., 2026b ) is direct corpus interaction applied to the workspace: the agent works on the files with terminal tools, leaving the state of the task to its context window.
paragraphs.zh: DCI（Li 等人，2026b）是一种直接作用于工作区的语料库交互方法：智能体使用终端工具处理文件，并将任务状态保留在上下文窗口中。

paragraphs.en: TODO follows plan-first prompting ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , asking the agent to begin by writing a TODO list of every fact, figure, and deliverable element the task asks for.
paragraphs.zh: TODO 遵循“计划优先”提示方法（Wang 等人，2023），要求智能体首先编写一个 TODO 清单，列出任务所要求的每一项事实、数据和交付成果。

paragraphs.en: Self-Refine ( Madaan et al., 2023 ) has the model review and refine its own output; at the first stop, one message asks the agent to re-check each of these elements against the source files it read and to make sure that each is in the deliverable before finishing again.
paragraphs.zh: 自我优化（Madaan 等人，2023）让模型审查并优化其自身的输出；在第一步中，一条消息会要求智能体根据已读取的源文件重新检查这些要素中的每一个，并确保每个要素都包含在交付成果中，然后再再次完成。

paragraphs.en: Self-Tracking combines the two, as in model-kept records of task progress ( Fourney et al., 2024 ; Ko et al., 2026 ) : the agent lists these elements at the start and re-checks them at the end.
paragraphs.zh: 自我追踪将两者结合，例如在模型维护的任务进展记录中（Fourney 等，2024；Ko 等，2026）：智能体在开始时列出这些要素，并在结束时重新检查它们。

paragraphs.en: RunningTab is our framework, in which the environment-side tab keeps track of the task.
paragraphs.zh: RunningTab 是我们的框架，其中环境侧的标签页负责跟踪任务。

paragraphs.en: Following Li et al. (2026b) , all methods use DCI-Agent-Lite, a terminal agent built on the Pi harness 1 1 1 https://github.com/earendil-works/pi , with its terminal tools (such as read and bash ), a budget of 300 turns, and runtime context management at level 3 (which truncates each observation and clears older observations as they accumulate), to which we add a time limit of one hour per task. We instantiate every method with three LLMs: GPT-5.4 nano ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , DeepSeek V4 Flash ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) , and Gemini 3.8 Flash ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) . Where the evaluation calls for an LLM judge, we follow the protocol of each benchmark and use GPT-5.4 mini. For RunningTab, the calls to the tab operations are removed from the trajectory that the evaluators read, and its settings stay the same across benchmarks and models. We report the average over three runs.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 Li 等人（2026b）的做法，所有方法均使用 DCI-Agent-Lite——这是一个基于 Pi harness 1 1 1 https://github.com/earendil-works/pi 构建的终端智能体，配备其终端工具（如 read 和 bash）、300 步的预算以及第 3 级的运行时上下文管理（该机制会截断每次观察结果，并在旧观察结果累积时将其清除），此外，我们为每个任务增加了一小时的时间限制。我们将每种方法实例化为三种大型语言模型：GPT-5.4 nano（OpenAI，2026）、DeepSeek V4 Flash（DeepSeek-AI，2026）和 Gemini 3.8 Flash（Google DeepMind，2026）。当评估需要 LLM 裁判时，我们遵循各基准测试的协议，使用 GPT-5.4 mini。对于 RunningTab，评估者读取的轨迹中已移除对 tab 操作的调用，且其设置在各基准测试和模型之间保持一致。我们报告三次运行结果的平均值。

paragraphs.en: We report the main results in Table 1 , where RunningTab achieves the best performance on every benchmark, metric, and LLM. In contrast, the baselines in which the model keeps track of the task (by listing what the task asks for at the start, re-checking the deliverable at the end, or both) remain far less effective, suggesting that the gains of RunningTab come not from instructing the model to keep track of the task but from the record that the environment keeps on its behalf, outside the context window. These gains hold across workspace settings, from assembling deliverables from office files (Workspace-Bench) and carrying out company tasks (TheAgentCompany) to answering questions from decades of archives (OfficeQA Pro).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在表 1 中报告了主要结果，其中 RunningTab 在每个基准测试、指标和 LLM 上都取得了最佳性能。 相比之下，模型需要持续跟踪任务（通过在开头列出任务要求、在结尾重新检查交付成果，或两者兼用）的基线方法效果仍差得多，这表明 RunningTab 的性能提升并非源于指示模型持续跟踪任务，而是源于环境为其保留的记录——这些记录位于上下文窗口之外。 无论是在哪些工作区设置中，这些性能优势都保持一致：从整合办公文件中的交付成果（Workspace-Bench）、执行公司任务（TheAgentCompany），到回答基于数十年档案资料的问题（OfficeQA Pro）。

paragraphs.en: To understand what the environment-side tab provides to the agent, we first examine its contents on Workspace-Bench. As shown in Table 3 , the tab holds a substantial record of each task: a median of four to five requirements, 6 to 18 read-log entries (each storing the text that the agent saw when it read a file, together with the path of that file) drawn from 5 to 11 distinct files and holding 12K to 40K characters of excerpted text, and 147 to 294 files that were listed but not opened. Moreover, the review brings this record to each requirement: when the agent pulls the review, 69.9% to 88.0% of its open requirements are shown beside a read-log entry whose excerpt contains a line with words of the requirement, so that, for most requirements, the review points the agent to a matching passage from a file it has already read.
paragraphs.zh: 为了理解环境侧标签为智能体提供了哪些信息，我们首先考察了它在 Workspace-Bench 上的内容。 如表 3 所示，该标签记录了每项任务的详细信息：中位数是四到五个需求、6 到 18 条读取日志记录（每条记录包含智能体阅读文件时看到的文本以及该文件的路径），这些记录来自 5 到 11 个不同的文件，包含 1.2 万到 4 万个字符的摘录文本，以及 147 到 294 个仅列出但未打开的文件。 此外，该审查过程将这些记录与每个需求关联起来：当智能体调取审查结果时，69.9% 到 88.0% 的已开启需求会显示在一条读取日志记录旁边，而该摘录中包含需求关键词所在的那一行，因此对于大多数需求，审查结果都能引导智能体定位到其已读文件中的匹配段落。

paragraphs.en: With DCI, about one in five of the rubric values shown to the agent is absent from its deliverable ( Figure 2 , bottom). We check whether, with RunningTab, such values are held in the tab: for each numeric value that a failed rubric expects, that appears in an observation of the agent, and that is absent from the deliverable, we test whether the read log stores it. As shown in Figure 4 (left), with GPT-5.4 nano, the tab holds 94.8% of these values 2 2 2 The read log keeps only file content ( Section 3.3 ), not a value the agent computes (such as a sum) or sees only in a listing. , so the missing content has in most cases been captured by the environment. We further test whether it is usable: for the requirements whose values the deliverable left out entirely, the same LLM, given the task and the requirement with its values masked, recovers 8.4% of the values held in the tab without the tab, 45.8% from the review of the tab for that requirement and the entries it chooses to open, and 78.1% from the whole read log ( Figure 4 , right), so the review brings back more than half of what the full log provides while using a small fraction of its text. Consistently, RunningTab succeeds on more rubrics in the Shown but Missing category ( Figure 2 , top) than DCI (27.0% against 20.7%).
paragraphs.zh: 使用 DCI 时，展示给智能体的评分标准值中约有五分之一并未出现在其交付成果中（图 2，底部）。 我们检查 RunningTab 是否将这些值保留在表格中：对于每个失败的评分标准所期望的数值，如果该数值出现在对智能体的观察中但缺失于交付成果，我们会测试读取日志是否存储了它。 如图 4（左侧）所示，使用 GPT-5.4 nano 时，表格保留了这些值的 94.8% 2 2 2 读取日志仅保留文件内容（第 3.3 节），而非智能体计算出的值（如总和）或仅在列表中看到的值。因此，缺失的内容在大多数情况下已被环境捕获。 我们进一步测试其可用性：对于交付成果完全遗漏数值的评分标准，同一 LLM 在给定任务以及数值被遮蔽的评分标准后，无需表格即可恢复出表格中存储的 8.4% 的数值；通过审查该评分标准的表格及其选择打开的条目可恢复 45.8%；通过整个读取日志则可恢复 78.1%（图 4，右侧）。因此，审查过程能找回完整日志所提供内容的一半以上，同时仅使用其中极小一部分文本。 与此一致的是，RunningTab 在“已展示但缺失”类别中成功处理的评分标准比 DCI 更多（图 2，顶部），分别为 27.0% 和 20.7%。

paragraphs.en: We then examine how the agent operates the tab, reported in Table 3 , which shows that each LLM draws on the tab in its own way. Specifically, Gemini 3.8 Flash works mainly through the review: it states its requirements and pulls the review before the finish check in every analyzed attempt, and in 76.9% of attempts it resolves a requirement as done by citing a read-log entry that the review listed for that requirement. GPT-5.4 nano instead relies on the finish check: it often turns to the tab only when the check prompts it, and after the check it operates the tab in 72.6% of attempts and edits its deliverable in 17.1%; it also re-reads stored entries with show in 74.6% of attempts. Lastly, DeepSeek V4 Flash works mainly through the candidates: like Gemini 3.8 Flash, it states its requirements before the finish check in every analyzed attempt, but it then explores more widely, reading the most distinct files (a median of 11 in Table 3 ) and opening a file that the tab listed as not yet opened in 54.7% of attempts.

paragraphs.en: To examine how much each component of the environment-side tab contributes to the performance gains, we remove one component at a time on Workspace-Bench with GPT-5.4 nano and report the results in Table 4 . paragraphs.en: In this work, we presented RunningTab, a framework for direct workspace interaction, the setting in which an agent searches and reads the files of a workspace from a terminal to produce a deliverable. Motivated by the observation that what the task asks for and what the agent has read are typically left to the context window, we equipped the agent with an environment-side tab: a per-task record that the environment keeps outside the context window. Specifically, the agent states the requirements, and the environment records each read as an excerpt with its source and each file listed but not opened as a candidate. The agent can then review each open requirement beside its best-matching excerpts and candidates, resolve it by citing the excerpt that supplies it or by giving a reason, and receive a finish check at its stop. Empirical evaluations on three benchmarks with three LLMs show that RunningTab improves over direct workspace interaction alone and over baselines in which the model itself keeps track of the task. Ablations attribute most of this gain to what the environment captures on its own, and the tab usually holds the values a deliverable needs once seen. We believe these findings position the environment-side tab as a natural complement to direct access: terminal tools let the agent reach any file, and the tab keeps track of the task until the deliverable is handed in.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 RunningTab——一个用于直接工作区交互的框架。在这种设定中，智能体通过终端搜索和读取工作区中的文件，以生成最终成果。 鉴于任务要求与智能体已读内容通常只能依赖上下文窗口这一观察结果，我们为智能体配备了一个环境侧标签：即由环境在上下文窗口之外维护的每个任务的专属记录。 具体而言，智能体会陈述需求，而环境则会将每次读取的内容以摘录形式记录，并标注其来源；对于已列出但未打开的文件，则作为候选项保存。 随后，智能体可以在每个已开启的需求旁查看最匹配的摘录和候选项，通过引用提供该需求的摘录或给出理由来解决需求，并在任务结束时获得完成确认。 在三个基准测试中，使用三种大型语言模型进行的实证评估表明，RunningTab 相较于单独的直接工作区交互以及由模型自身追踪任务的基线方法均有显著提升。 消融实验显示，这种性能提升主要源于环境自主捕获的信息，而标签通常已包含生成成果所需的关键值。 我们相信这些发现确立了环境侧标签作为直接访问的自然补充：终端工具使智能体能够访问任何文件，而标签则持续追踪任务进展，直至最终成果被提交。

paragraphs.en: This work aims to improve how LLM agents produce deliverables from the files of a workspace, using existing models and public benchmarks. However, agents with RunningTab may retain the biases and errors of their models, and since the tab stores excerpts of the files the agent reads, it may hold sensitive content in real workspaces. paragraphs.en: As the first case study, we compare DCI and RunningTab with the same LLM on a task that asks for a water and electricity saving manual compiled from four policy files ( Table 6 ). Although both methods read the same four files within a few turns, they differ in what they keep track of. DCI writes the manual soon after reading the files, leaving the state of the task to its context window. In contrast, with RunningTab, the agent first states one requirement per policy file (A), and the environment records each file it reads as a read-log entry (B); after writing the manual, the agent sees each requirement beside its matching entries in the review (C), resolves it against the entry of its own file (D), and receives a finish check confirming that none is left open (E). In the end, the manual of RunningTab keeps all five chapters and twenty articles of the policy in their original order, whereas that of DCI merges them into an outline of its own and loses the chapter structure.
paragraphs.zh: 作为第一个案例研究，我们在一个需要基于四个政策文件编写水电节约手册的任务中（表 6），将 DCI 和 RunningTab 与相同的 LLM 进行了比较。 尽管两种方法都在几次交互内读取了相同的四个文件，但它们在追踪的内容上有所不同。 DCI 在读取文件后不久就编写了手册，并将任务状态保留在其上下文窗口中。 相比之下，在使用 RunningTab 时，智能体首先针对每个政策文件提出一个要求（A），环境则将其读取的每个文件记录为一条读取日志条目（B）；编写手册后，智能体在审查阶段会看到每个要求及其对应的日志条目（C），并据此解决该要求（D），最终收到一个确认没有未解决要求的完成检查（E）。 最终，RunningTab 的手册保留了政策文件中全部五个章节和二十个条款的原始顺序，而 DCI 的手册则将其合并为自身的一个大纲，并丢失了原有的章节结构。

paragraphs.en: As the second case study, we consider a task that asks for a table summarizing ten purchase orders by supplier ( Table 7 ), where every order is expected in its own row. With DCI, the agent reads the orders one at a time, including that of Supplier 15 with the largest amount (¥55,000), yet the table it writes holds a single row, so the suppliers it has read do not reach the deliverable. With RunningTab, the environment records each order as a read-log entry as the agent reads it. Then, when the finish check reminds the agent that no requirement is recorded, the agent states one requirement per row, naming the supplier, status, amount, and source order, and resolves each against the entry of that order (such as the row of Supplier 15 against L12). In the end, the table of RunningTab holds a row for every supplier, each tied in the tab to the order it comes from.
paragraphs.zh: 作为第二个案例研究，我们考虑一个任务，要求生成一个表格来总结十个按供应商分类的采购订单（表 7），其中每个订单都应单独占一行。 使用 DCI 时，智能体逐个读取订单，包括金额最大的供应商 15 的订单（¥55,000），但它生成的表格中只有一行，因此它读取的供应商并未满足交付要求。 使用 RunningTab 时，当智能体读取每个订单时，环境会将其记录为一条读取日志条目。 然后，当完成检查提醒智能体尚未记录任何要求时，智能体会按行陈述每个要求，注明供应商、状态、金额和原始订单，并将其与对应订单的条目进行核对（例如，将供应商 15 的行与 L12 核对）。 最终，RunningTab 的表格中为每个供应商都有一行，且每一行在表格中都与对应的原始订单相关联。
